review_candidates.title: Software Presale Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Mirnah Mirnah Technology Systems(Mirnah) is a Saudi Arabian software company that specializes in Sales Force Automation, eCommerce, Forecasting, Asset Management and Inventory Software – revolutionizing the way businesses manage their financial transactions and inventory on the go. Our innovative software seamlessly integrates accounting processes with route planning, providing businesses with a comprehensive solution for efficient and accurate financial management. Our Enterprise Mobility software products are designed to streamline operations for a wide range of industries, including distribution, delivery, field sales and government. With real-time tracking and automation features, businesses can optimize their routes, enhance order accuracy, and maximize productivity. The software also facilitates secure and transparent financial transactions, enabling businesses to manage sales, inventory, and customer accounts effortlessly. The role Mirnah’s customers buy outcomes, not features: a van salesman who can invoice, collect and reconcile stock on one device; a warehouse that stays in step with the ERP; a planning team that sees demand coming. Pre-sales is where those outcomes are first shown to be achievable — in discovery sessions, demonstrations and proposals that the delivery team can later stand behind. The Software Pre-Sales Engineer supports the sales team throughout the technical and solution-selling cycle by understanding customer requirements, designing suitable solutions, conducting demonstrations, preparing technical proposals, and coordinating technical and delivery teams. The role is the technical counterpart to the Sales Account Manager on each opportunity, responsible for making sure that what is proposed is technically sound, clearly scoped and deliverable. What you'll do Discovery and Requirements Sales partnership — work closely with the sales team to understand customer business and technical requirements. Discovery — conduct discovery sessions and requirement-gathering meetings with customers. Clarification — assist the sales team during technical and commercial clarification meetings. Solution Design Solution design — translate customer requirements into suitable solution designs built on Mirnah’s portfolio — RoutePro, OrderPro, StockPro, AssetPro, ForecastPro and Business Analytics. Architecture — explain solution architecture, integration requirements, hosting options and technical capabilities. Integration — support discussions related to APIs, ERP, CRM, WMS, cloud, mobility and enterprise integrations, including connections to ERPs such as SAP, Oracle Fusion and JD Edwards. Risk — identify technical risks, gaps and dependencies during the sales cycle, and make sure they are reflected in the proposal. Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept Presentations — prepare and deliver solution presentations, demonstrations and proofs of concept. Demo environments — maintain demo environments, presentation materials and technical documentation. Proposals and Tenders Technical proposals — prepare technical proposals, solution descriptions, scopes of work and related documentation. Tenders — support RFP, RFI and tender responses, including technical compliance and clarifications. Coordination and Handover Internal coordination — coordinate with technical, product, implementation and delivery teams. Handover — support the proper handover of awarded projects to the implementation and project teams. Product feedback — pass recurring customer requirements and competitive gaps back to the product team. Market and Product Knowledge Keep up to date with market trends, competitor solutions and customer requirements. Maintain in-depth, hands-on knowledge of Mirnah’s products, their configuration options and their integration capabilities. Handle customer information, requirements and system details confidentially, in line with Mirnah policies. What you'll bring 1 to 5 years’ experience in software pre-sales, business analysis, solution consulting, implementation or a similar role. Arabic is required , together with English, spoken and written. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong presentation, communication and customer-facing skills. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work closely with sales, technical and delivery teams. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and presentation tools. Willing and able to travel within Saudi Arabia for customer workshops, demonstrations and meetings. Nice to have Experience with enterprise software, cloud solutions, APIs, databases, mobility and integrations. Good understanding of business processes in FMCG, distribution, supply chain, logistics or field sales. Familiarity with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle Fusion or JD Edwards, and with how field and warehouse data flows into them. Experience with sales force automation, van sales, warehouse management or demand planning solutions. Exposure to rugged mobile devices and enterprise device management, such as Honeywell devices and SOTI. Experience with reporting and analytics tools such as Qlik. Experience preparing RFP, RFI and tender responses. How we work Consultative approach - asks the questions that uncover the real requirement before proposing an answer. Technical credibility - explains architecture and integration clearly and accurately to business and IT audiences alike. Clear communication - turns complex solutions into clear presentations and documents, in Arabic or English. Analytical thinking - breaks a customer’s operation down into processes, data and integration points. Realism - proposes only what can be delivered and raises risks openly. Collaboration - works as one team with sales, product and delivery colleagues. Organisation - runs several opportunities, demos and deadlines in parallel without losing detail. How success is measured The role is measured on the quality of the solutions it proposes and its contribution to winning business. These are the main measures; specific objectives are set and reviewed by the Sales Manager. Discovery - Captures customer business and technical requirements fully and accurately before a solution is proposed. Solution design - Proposes solutions that fit the requirement, are clearly scoped and can be delivered as sold. Demonstrations - Delivers demonstrations and proofs of concept built around the customer’s own scenarios. Proposals and tenders - Delivers technical proposals and RFP, RFI and tender responses on time and to a consistent standard. Risk - Identifies technical risks, gaps and dependencies early, before they become commitments. Sales contribution - Helps the sales team move opportunities forward and win them. Handover - Hands over awarded projects with complete scope, requirements and commitments, so implementation starts without rework. Demo readiness - Keeps demo environments and presentation materials current and ready for use at short notice. Working relationships Reports to the Sales Manager within the Sales / Commercial department. Works alongside Sales Account Managers as the technical lead on their opportunities, and coordinates with technical, product, implementation and delivery teams on solution design, scoping and handover. Externally, works with customers’ business, IT and operations teams, and with technology partners where a solution includes their products. Where and when The role is based in Mirnah’s offices in Saudi Arabia and combines office work - solution design, documentation and demo preparation — with workshops, presentations and demonstrations at customer premises. Travel within Saudi Arabia is required, sometimes at short notice, and the role may involve setting up and operating demonstration equipment such as rugged handheld devices.

review_candidates.title: Project Coordinator (Events)
review_candidates.description: Trinity Outsourcing Solutions is dedicated to connecting talented professionals with dynamic career opportunities across the world. As a trusted HR partner, Trinity offers a pathway for skilled individuals to work in roles that align with their expertise and support their career advancement. Known for fostering a supportive and growth-focused environment, Trinity provides hands-on experience and tailored opportunities for development. By prioritizing meaningful placements, Trinity enables professionals to unlock their potential and make a lasting impact within innovative companies. About the client: The Ortus Club The Ortus Club is a B2B marketing company specializing in virtual and in-person knowledge-sharing discussions.  Our experienced team runs approximately 50 events a month, striving to curate intimate gatherings that bring together senior executives and thought leaders across various industries. We help them create meaningful connections and insightful discussions that can start innovative business relationships by providing an environment for them to engage in candid conversations, share best practices, and explore new opportunities. We are a young, multicultural team of 130, scattered around the world with offices in the Philippines, Italy, and Kosovo. We encourage you to take a look at our Meet the Team section on our careers page ! Our Values We think big We always deliver We believe in knowledge-sharing We connect with purpose We can all belong at the roundtable The Role 📍 Pristina, Kosovo (hybrid) 🕙 9 AM - 6 PM CET As Project Coordinator, you will utilise large data sets to identify and attract top decision-makers and act as a bridge to solidify relationships between those in the executive level.  Additionally, you'll be responsible for assisting in the planning and execution of events, from conception to completion. This includes coordinating with clients and suppliers to ensure that all requirements are met, and liaising with internal teams to ensure that all aspects of the event are delivered on time and to a high standard. You'll create and manage project plans and timelines, ensuring that events are delivered on schedule and within budget. After events, you'll provide feedback and analysis to clients and internal teams to identify areas for improvement and ensure that future events are even more successful. Responsibilities: Responsible for coordinating and executing all logistical and guesting-related aspects of assigned events, ensuring that they are completed within the provided timeline and lead to project success Create leads lists based on project briefs and gather a wide range of data, such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, and job titles from target accounts utilizing various resources, including our internal database, LinkedIn, Google, and other relevant sources Curate and personalize email invitations to be sent to potential guests based on the project briefing, taking into consideration target audience, and incorporating relevant details and information to make the invitation more appealing and engaging. Make calls (including cold calls) to invite potential guests using professional and senior language Source, build, and nurture relationships with potential moderators, key speakers, and industry experts to ensure the quality and relevance of our sessions Collaborate with other departments to continuously improve our events and create a positive and impactful guest and client experience Maintain accurate records and data, and ensuring the timely completion of administrative tasks related to your project Developing a networking strategy aimed at arranging face-to-face meetings with global decision-makers, such as chairmen, CEOs, COOs, and other high-level executives; identifying key individuals and establishing connections with them to create opportunities for meetings and discussions Provide post-event feedback and analysis to clients and internal teams to identify areas for improvement and to ensure that future events are even more successful Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree from a leading university Fresh graduates and entry-level candidates are welcome to apply Fluency in English Excellent presentation and communication skills Fast learner and keen attention to detail Capacity to adapt to different environments and out-of-the-box situations Impeccable work ethic and high level of energy Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively Why you should join the club: Paid leaves (after 6 months) Company equipment (Macbook Air) Monthly performance appraisal during your first 6 months (and then quarterly thereafter) Anniversary bonus + company merch for milestones Team hangouts and company-wide events Quarterly project bonus* Excellence performance bonus* Opportunity to travel to global event locations and network with top executives Opportunity to become a Master of Ceremonies at domestic and global events *Additional bonuses may vary Elevate your career with The Ortus Club and be part of something extraordinary in the dynamic world of B2B marketing events!

review_candidates.title: Product Marketing Manager
review_candidates.description: Product Marketing Manager | Tokyo, Japan | A global platform powering digital businesses across multiple markets is looking for its first dedicated Product Marketing Manager in Japan. The organization provides critical infrastructure behind online commerce and works closely with enterprise and growth-stage businesses to help them scale. About the role This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, Engineering, and Sales. You will own go-to-market strategy for new products and features, shaping positioning, messaging, launch planning, merchant engagement, and adoption performance. Working across both Japanese and international stakeholders, you will help ensure new products reach the market with clear alignment, strong communication, and measurable business impact. What makes this role stand out The opportunity to build a Product Marketing function from the ground up. You will have the visibility and ownership to influence product direction, improve cross-functional collaboration, establish launch processes, and help drive adoption of high-impact products in a fast-moving fintech and digital commerce environment. The ideal background Product Marketing, GTM, Growth Product Management, or commercial product roles within fintech, payments, B2B SaaS, eCommerce, or platform businesses. Strong Japanese and English communication skills are essential, along with the ability to influence stakeholders, navigate ambiguity, and proactively move initiatives forward. If you are looking for a role where you can create structure, lead product launches, and make a visible impact across the business, apply now or reach out for a confidential conversation.
